calls.statement:
SELECT 
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 107
    AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5

SELECT 
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    s.city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS transaction_lines,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 107
    AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.city

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    SUM(COALESCE(f.quantity, 0)) AS gross_units_sold,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned, 0)) AS units_returned,
    SUM(COALESCE(f.quantity, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned, 0)) AS net_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 107
    AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5
